```{r}
save_plot_bundle <- function(plot, stem, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  svglite::svglite(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".svg")), width = width, height = height, bg = "transparent")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")), width = width, height = height, family = "Arial")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  ragg::agg_png(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")), width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}
```

## Network Descriptive Statistics
```{r}

library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

network_labels <- c(
  "Friendship",
  "Daily-activity",
  "Personal life-sharing",
  "Gossip-sharing",
  "Positive-cooperation",
  "Negative-cooperation"
)

network_descriptive_raw <- map2_dfr(
  network_labels,
  network_igraphs,
  function(label, g) {
    nominations <- igraph::degree(g, mode = "out", loops = FALSE)
    tibble(
      Network = label,
      Number_of_nodes = igraph::vcount(g),
      Density = igraph::edge_density(g, loops = FALSE),
      Mean_nominations = mean(nominations),
      SD_nominations = sd(nominations),
      Number_of_ties = igraph::gsize(g)
    )
  }
)

network_descriptive_raw
```

## Out-degree Range
```{r}
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)

network_labels <- c(
  "Friendship",
  "Daily-activity",
  "Personal life-sharing",
  "Gossip-sharing",
  "Positive-cooperation",
  "Negative-cooperation"
)


nom_desc <- map2_dfr(1:6, network_labels, function(j, nm) {
  g <- SNmF_igraph[[j]]
  outdeg <- igraph::degree(g, mode = "out")
  
  tibble(
    network = nm,
    Min = min(outdeg, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(outdeg, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
})

nom_desc
```

## Adjacency Matrices
```{r}
library(igraph)
library(sna)

graph_list <- setNames(
  SNmF_igraph[seq_along(network_labels)],
  network_labels
)
lapply(graph_list, function(g) igraph::V(g)$name)

adj_list <- lapply(graph_list, function(g) {
  as.matrix(igraph::as_adjacency_matrix(g, sparse = FALSE))
})
```

## QAP Tests
```{r}
net_names <- names(adj_list)
pair_index <- combn(seq_along(adj_list), 2, simplify = FALSE)

set.seed(27)

qap_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pair_index, function(idx) {
  i <- idx[1]
  j <- idx[2]

  qap_res <- sna::qaptest(
    list(adj_list[[i]], adj_list[[j]]),
    sna::gcor,
    g1 = 1,
    g2 = 2,
    reps = 5000
  )

  r_val <- unname(qap_res$testval)
  p_val <- (sum(abs(qap_res$dist) >= abs(qap_res$testval)) + 1) / (length(qap_res$dist) + 1)

  data.frame(
    network1 = net_names[i],
    network2 = net_names[j],
    r = round(r_val, 3),
    p = sprintf("%.4f", p_val)
  )
}))

qap_results
write.csv(qap_results, file.path(output_dir, "qap_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Fig S2: Within-centrality correlation across networks
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

network_names <- c(
  "Friendship",
  "Daily-activity",
  "Personal life-sharing",
  "Gossip-sharing",
  "Positive-cooperation",
  "Negative-cooperation"
)

centrality_labels <- c(
  indegree = "In-degree",
  outdegree = "Out-degree",
  betweenness = "Betweenness",
  eigen = "Eigenvector"
)

cor_method <- "spearman"

cor_with_p <- function(x, y, method = "spearman") {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  if (length(x) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(x) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(y) < 2) {
    return(c(r = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }
  
  test <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = method, exact = FALSE))
  c(r = unname(test$estimate), p = test$p.value)
}

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p < .001 ~ "***",
    p < .01 ~ "**",
    p < .05 ~ "*",
    
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

within_centrality_network_correlation <- function(centrality_type) {
  centrality_cols <- net_index_by_ind[[centrality_type]]
  
  expand.grid(
    network_x_id = seq_along(centrality_cols),
    network_y_id = seq_along(centrality_cols),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      centrality_x = centrality_cols[network_x_id],
      centrality_y = centrality_cols[network_y_id],
      cor_stats = purrr::map2(
        centrality_x,
        centrality_y,
        ~ cor_with_p(post_final[[.x]], post_final[[.y]], method = cor_method)
      ),
      r = purrr::map_dbl(cor_stats, "r"),
      p = purrr::map_dbl(cor_stats, "p"),
      p = ifelse(network_x_id == network_y_id, NA_real_, p),
      sig = p_to_stars(p),
      label = ifelse(is.na(r), "", paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r), sig)),
      network_x = factor(
        network_names[network_x_id],
        levels = network_names
      ),
      network_y = factor(
        network_names[network_y_id],
        levels = rev(network_names)
      ),
      centrality_type = factor(
        centrality_type,
        levels = net_ind,
        labels = centrality_labels[net_ind]
      )
    ) %>%
    select(centrality_type, network_x_id, network_y_id, network_x, network_y, r, p, sig, label)
}

within_centrality_network_cor <- purrr::map_dfr(
  net_ind,
  within_centrality_network_correlation
)

within_centrality_network_heatmap <- ggplot(
  within_centrality_network_cor %>%
    filter(network_y_id > network_x_id),
  aes(x = network_x, y = network_y, fill = r)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 4) +
  facet_wrap(~ centrality_type, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B6EA8",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B4493F",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Spearman's ρ"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

within_centrality_network_cor
within_centrality_network_heatmap
```

## Fig S2: Within-network correlation across centrality indices
```{r}
within_network_centrality_correlation <- function(i) {
  centrality_cols <- net_index_by_net[[i]]
  
  expand.grid(
    centrality_x_id = seq_along(centrality_cols),
    centrality_y_id = seq_along(centrality_cols),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      centrality_x = centrality_cols[centrality_x_id],
      centrality_y = centrality_cols[centrality_y_id],
      cor_stats = purrr::map2(
        centrality_x,
        centrality_y,
        ~ cor_with_p(post_final[[.x]], post_final[[.y]], method = cor_method)
      ),
      r = purrr::map_dbl(cor_stats, "r"),
      p = purrr::map_dbl(cor_stats, "p"),
      p = ifelse(centrality_x_id == centrality_y_id, NA_real_, p),
      sig = p_to_stars(p),
      label = ifelse(
        is.na(r),
        "",
        paste0(ifelse(sprintf("%.2f", r) == "-0.00", "0.00", sprintf("%.2f", r)), sig)
      ),
      centrality_x_type = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", centrality_x),
      centrality_y_type = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", centrality_y),
      centrality_x_type = factor(
        centrality_x_type,
        levels = net_ind,
        labels = centrality_labels[net_ind]
      ),
      centrality_y_type = factor(
        centrality_y_type,
        levels = rev(net_ind),
        labels = rev(centrality_labels[net_ind])
      ),
      network = factor(network_names[i], levels = network_names)
    ) %>%
    select(
      network,
      centrality_x_id,
      centrality_y_id,
      centrality_x_type,
      centrality_y_type,
      r,
      p,
      sig,
      label
    )
}

within_network_centrality_cor <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(n_net),
  within_network_centrality_correlation
)

within_network_centrality_heatmap <- ggplot(

) +
```
